name: Molten
author: Erin Carter
description: A cluster of liquid-chrome blobs merging and parting like mercury — raymarched 3D metal with mirror reflections of a palette-tinted studio environment, crisp specular highlights and grazing fresnel. Fills the frame as a close-up of flowing metal.

params.label: Flow
params.effect: How fast the metal flows and the blobs merge and part; 0 freezes the cluster.

params.label: Merge
params.effect: Softness of the blob welds; low keeps distinct beads, high fuses them into smooth liquid bridges.

params.label: Spread
params.effect: How far the blobs roam from the centre; low packs a tight knot, high scatters them across the frame.

params.label: Polish
params.effect: Mirror finish — sharpness and brightness of the specular highlights, from satin to high-gloss chrome.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer parallaxes the camera around the cluster; 0 ignores the mouse.
